desc: Migration of pre 0.4.5 SQLAlchemy migrate repositories
u: migrate-repository - Migration of pre 0.4.5 SQLAlchemy migrate repositories

SQLAlchemy migrate uses a new repository format since version 0.4.5.

All documentation for migrate is available in HTML format under /usr/share/doc/python-migrate/html.

migrate was written by Evan Rosson <evan.rosson@gmail.com>. The package was taken over by a group of volunteers when Evan had no free time for maintaining it.

This manual page was written by Jan Dittberner <jan@dittberner.info>, for the Debian project (but may be used by others).
